youtube_title: Holy Bible Reading: Psalms 117 (KJV) | Deep Sleep & Peace

chapters.spoken_script: [empathy] Welcome to the reading of God's Holy Word. Today, we are reading from the book of Psalms, chapter [shimmer] 117. [whisper] Let your *HEART* be still and *RECEIVE* His truth.

[scripture] [shimmer] Verse 1. O *PRAISE* the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people. [joy] [swell] Verse 2. For his merciful kindness is *GREAT* toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth *FOR EVER*. [amen] [bell] Praise ye the LORD.
[warfare] [boom] May the Lord *BLESS* the reading of His Holy Word, [swell] and may it bring *PEACE* and *STRENGTH* to your soul. [amen] In Jesus' name, [bell] Amen.

[scripture][shimmer] Verse 7. Thou hast put *GLADNESS* in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased. [joy] Verse 8. I will both lay me down in *PEACE*, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in *SAFETY*.
[amen] May the Lord *BLESS* the reading of His Holy Word, and may it bring [swell] deep peace and *STRENGTH* to your soul. [amen] [bell] In *JESUS'* name, Amen.
